description: This Java class, AttributesModelFactory, is a utility class that provides static methods for creating, initializing, and validating Attributes objects used within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package. It includes methods for returning empty or null Attributes, constructing Attributes from JsonObjects or JSON strings, creating builders, and validating JsonPointers and JsonObjects for correctness according to certain patterns.

classes.name: AttributesModelFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing static factory and validation methods for Attributes objects used in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package.

methods.name: emptyAttributes
methods.description: Returns a new immutable empty Attributes instance.

methods.name: nullAttributes
methods.description: Returns a new immutable Attributes instance representing a null-like Attributes.

methods.name: newAttributes
methods.description: Creates Attributes initialized with values from a JsonObject; throws NullPointerException if input is null, or JsonPointerInvalidException if JSON is invalid.

methods.name: newAttributes
methods.description: Creates Attributes from a JSON string, parsing it into a JsonObject first.

methods.name: newAttributesBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new empty builder for Attributes.

methods.name: newAttributesBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder initialized with values from the provided JsonObject.

methods.name: validateAttributePointer
methods.description: Validates a JsonPointer as an attribute key according to defined patterns.

methods.name: validateAttributeKeys
methods.description: Validates the keys of a JsonObject as attribute keys.
